topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Walking down the hallway, the walls seemed to shift hues with each step, the echo of my footsteps blending oddly with the hum of the fluorescent lights. My desk, once a familiar sanctuary, now looks like a cluster of misplaced hopes and open notebooks. A notice on the bulletin board announces my transfer to another department, the ink bold and defiant against the paper's stark whiteness. I pause, a cup of lukewarm coffee in hand, sipping absently as I ponder the new corridors I’ll explore, the new faces that will blur into a mosaic of mornings and afternoons. The day stretches before me, marked by the same sun that rises over a sea of unfamiliar possibilities.
